up: Retrieve exact activity measurements (with standard_relation '=', standard_value, standard_units, and standard_type) and the corresponding compound structures (canonical SMILES) for all compounds tested in the assay with ChEMBL identifier CHEMBL1614502. Include the compound ChEMBL ID for each record.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_type, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_relation FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614502' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.standard_value;
